request.style: English, deep southern soul, smooth male soul vocal with backing singers, Rhodes electric piano, Hammond organ, horn section, warm bass, steady drums, steadfast and stirring, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They searched his life for something wrong, but not a fault was there to see
So they went to King Darius with a ban and a decree
For thirty days, no prayer to any god or man but you
And the law of Medes and Persians says that no one can undo

[Verse]
When Daniel learned the ban was signed, he went home and climbed the stair
To the upper room with windows open toward Jerusalem in prayer

[Chorus]
Three times a day he got down on his knees
Giving thanks to his God
Just as he had always done
Three times a day, three times a day

[Verse]
They threw him in the lions' den, a stone was laid upon the door
The king sealed it with his signet ring, and he could do no more
He went back to his palace and he fasted through the night
And sleep fled from him, till he ran to the den at first light

[Verse]
Daniel, servant of the living God, the king cried out in fear
Has the God you serve continually been able to save you here
And Daniel called, O king, live forever, no harm has come to me
They lifted him out of the den, and not a wound was there to see

[Bridge]
My God sent his angel and shut the mouths of the lions
He rescues and he saves
He is the living God, enduring forever

[Chorus]
Three times a day he got down on his knees
Giving thanks to his God
Just as he had always done
Three times a day, three times a day

[Outro]
Just as he had always done
